title: Product sense
summary: Design a product end to end: users, problems, solutions, a first version and how you would measure it.

phases.title: Intro
phases.goal: Open in about thirty words: first name, round and length, the prompt in short, then ask where they would start, and call show_question.

phases.title: Goal
phases.goal: Give the prompt and call show_question. Answer questions about the goal and constraints briefly. Do not prompt for questions.

phases.title: Users
phases.goal: They list segments and pick one. Ask why that one first. If vague, ask 'Who exactly?'

phases.title: Problems
phases.goal: They list pain points for that segment and prioritise. Ask how they know each is real and why the top one matters most.

phases.title: Solutions
phases.goal: Ask for two or three ideas, then a pick with a reason, then the smallest first version. Ask what they would not build.

phases.title: Metrics
phases.goal: Ask for the success metric tied to the problem, a guardrail, and the biggest risk with a mitigation.

phases.title: Wrap up
phases.goal: Ask what version two looks like, or take one question. Close and call end_round.
